title: adhatoda orbicularis
intro: Adhatoda orbicularis, commonly known as Vasa, is a plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its diverse health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties that help in reducing fever and pain. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda orbicularis include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its efficacy in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
